description: Fix the bug where a failed / not-captured Razorpay payment still shows 'Your order is placed / Order placed successfully' on the /orders/placed confirmation page. When any order in the placed set has an unresolved payment (paymentNeedsAction(o) is true, i.e. a razorpay order still in stage 'received' whose PaymentStatus is not 'paid'), the confirmation page must NOT present success. Instead the header must read 'Payment Issue' with the message 'Try again later.' and use the danger/alert visual treatment, so the order is clearly surfaced as unsuccessful. The exact user-facing copy required is: 'Payment Issue. Try again later.' The order-detail page already has a full paymentIssuePanel; this feature brings the confirmation (placed) page in line so success is never shown for an unpaid Razorpay order.
steps: Study Lamazon_website/templates/pages/orders_templ.go for the existing helper paymentNeedsAction(o backend.Order) bool (o.Stage==backend.StageReceived && o.PaymentMethod=='razorpay' && o.PaymentStatus!='paid'). Reuse it; do not duplicate the condition.

In Lamazon_website/templates/pages/checkout.templ add a small pure Go helper in the file's func section, e.g. `func placedHasPaymentIssue(orders []backend.Order) bool { for _, o := range orders { if paymentNeedsAction(o) { return true } }; return false }`. This is the single decision point for the confirmation page.

In placedBody (checkout.templ), make the top header block conditional on placedHasPaymentIssue(d.Orders). Success branch (no payment issue): keep the current lime circle with ui.Icon("check", ...),

Your order is placed

, and the 'Order placed successfully. This page updates automatically...' paragraph. Payment-issue branch: render a danger-styled circle (use a red background such as bg-[#FBE5E7] with the existing danger color, replacing bg-lime) containing ui.Icon("circle-alert", "h-9 w-9"), an

reading 'Payment Issue', and a paragraph reading 'Try again later.' Do NOT render the words 'order placed' / 'placed successfully' in the payment-issue branch. Keep the surrounding structure (the notifyPermission card, totals card, per-order cards, Track order / Continue shopping links) intact for both branches; those per-order cards already call statusLabel(o) which returns 'Payment issue' and paymentColour(o) which returns the danger color, so they remain correct.

Mirror the exact same change by hand in the generated Lamazon_website/templates/pages/checkout_templ.go. The header currently lives in placedBody as WriteString segment 1 (the opening
, spacer div, and opening lime circle
) immediately followed by `ui.Icon("check", "h-9 w-9").Render(...)` and then WriteString segment 2 (which closes the circle div and emits

Your order is placed

Order placed successfully...

and continues into the notifyPermission card). Restructure so that: emit
, then `if placedHasPaymentIssue(d.Orders) {` emit the danger circle open div + ui.Icon("circle-alert", "h-9 w-9").Render + close div +

Payment Issue

Try again later.

`} else {` emit the lime circle open div + ui.Icon("check", "h-9 w-9").Render + close div +

Your order is placed

Order placed successfully. This page updates automatically when the store or rider moves it forward.

`}` then continue with the unchanged notifyPermission card and the rest. Preserve the templruntime.WriteString call pattern, the `if templ_7745c5c3_Err != nil { return templ_7745c5c3_Err }` error checks after every write/render, and use unique/incrementing segment index numbers so nothing collides. Keep both branches' HTML classes consistent with the existing design (text-title text-text for h1, mt-3 text-center text-body leading-[1.5] text-muted for the paragraph).
Ensure backend is imported/used correctly in checkout.templ (it already imports lamazon/website/backend). The new helper references backend.Order.
Run `gofmt -l` on both checkout.templ's generated file and any edited .go to confirm formatting; run `gofmt -w` if needed. Note: gofmt operates on .go files (checkout_templ.go), not on .templ files.

Add a Go test in Lamazon_website/templates/pages/checkout_test.go named e.g. TestPlacedPageShowsPaymentIssueForUnpaidRazorpay that builds orders and asserts placedHasPaymentIssue(...) is true for an unpaid razorpay order (backend.Order{Stage: backend.StageReceived, PaymentMethod: "razorpay", PaymentStatus: "due"}) and false for a paid one (PaymentStatus: "paid") and for a cod order. Follow the style of the existing TestPlacedPagePollsOnlyWhileAnOrderIsLive in the same file and TestUnpaidRazorpayOrderNeedsPaymentAction in payment_state_test.go.
acceptance_criteria: In checkout.templ and checkout_templ.go, when placedHasPaymentIssue(d.Orders) is true the confirmation page renders the heading text 'Payment Issue' and the message 'Try again later.' and shows the danger/alert icon (circle-alert) rather than the lime check, and does NOT render 'order placed' or 'placed successfully' anywhere in that branch.
When no order needs payment action, the page renders exactly the previous success content ('Your order is placed' + 'Order placed successfully. ...') with the lime check icon.
checkout.templ and checkout_templ.go are consistent with each other (the generated file reflects the same conditional structure and copy as the source).
A new test in checkout_test.go asserts placedHasPaymentIssue returns true for an unpaid razorpay order and false for paid and cod orders.
gofmt -l reports no issues on the edited .go files.
The offline-buildable packages (./backend/... ./shop/... ./viewdata/... in Lamazon_website) still build with GOPROXY=off.
verification: cd Lamazon_website && gofmt -l templates/pages/checkout_templ.go templates/pages/checkout_test.go (expect no output)
cd Lamazon_website && GOPROXY=off go build ./backend/... ./shop/... ./viewdata/... (expect exit 0)

Manual review: diff checkout.templ against checkout_templ.go to confirm the conditional header, exact strings 'Payment Issue' and 'Try again later.', and that the success branch is unchanged. (Full `go test ./templates/pages/...` and `go vet ./site/...` cannot run offline because a-h/templ and razorpay-go are Forbidden to download; record this in findings.)
